description:
Scope / functional specification and files: Coverage-only test addition for Zaq.Channels.MessageTimestamp.normalize/2. Exclusive test path: test/zaq/channels/message_timestamp_test.exs (edit existing file only). Production module lib/zaq/channels/message_timestamp.ex stays unchanged. The public contract in its @moduledoc says unknown transport dates remain absent, never substituted by receive time. No other test/support, fixtures, or documentation files are required; no new user journey/E2E.

Tests to add before implementation (implementation is tests only):
1. For missed line 22, call MessageTimestamp.normalize("not-an-iso-date", :iso8601) and assert exactly nil; optionally add one well-formed-looking but impossible calendar value such as "2026-13-02T12:00:00Z" with the same assertion to prove bad calendar parsing does not result in a timestamp. Each is a binary so it reaches DateTime.from_iso8601/1's non-ok branch, not the catch-all clause at line 33. Keep separate from the existing invalid :second input loop; using that format would miss line 22.
2. For missed line 29, call MessageTimestamp.normalize("not a date", :rfc2822) and assert exactly nil; optionally assert the same for "" as a blank mail Date header. These are binary so they reach Mail.Parsers.RFC2822.to_datetime/1, whose documented malformed-date return is {:error, input}; normalize/2 then takes the non-DateTime branch at line 29. Do not use nil or maps, which hit the catch-all instead. No exceptions expected for the chosen inputs; if an input unexpectedly parses or raises, select a deterministic malformed string supported by the real parser's error contract and record the observation before changing the plan.
3. Preserve the existing property 'transport units describe the same instant' and valid RFC date example; keep both so valid and invalid branches remain protected. Exact nil assertions prove no receive-time fallback. No wall-clock assertions, sleeps, networks, database or global state.

Branches/paths validated: lines 22 and 29 fallback expressions under binary format guards; existing tests retain ISO success line 21 and RFC success line 28, integer and unsupported-format paths. Test level: async unit test exercising the real public normalizer and real Mail parser. Fixtures/helper reuse: existing MessageTimestamp alias and current ExUnit.Case, async: true; literal malformed timestamp strings are the complete fixtures. No new helper or support module; no setup data. Mocking plan: none; RFC parser and DateTime are local deterministic collaborators, not external APIs. Isolation: keep async: true; no env, process, filesystem or Mox changes. Property assessment: existing StreamData property tests successful unit conversion over a broad bounded range; parser rejection for two concrete formats is better established with explicit examples than arbitrary garbage, so no new property is warranted for this focused coverage task. Avoid duplicating the production parser in expected-value calculations.

Action reuse assessment: not applicable — no executable operation added, changed or orchestrated; tests call the existing MessageTimestamp.normalize/2 API directly, with no Action/tool/workflow exposure. Documentation to update: none; no contract change. Blockers/unreachable: none identified: both missed branches are reachable through public normalize/2 with malformed binaries. If the reported line coverage cannot be reproduced in a fresh report, or parser behavior differs under installed dependency version, note exact blocker/results in this issue rather than changing production code or making test-only seams.

Validation handoff (not performed by planner): run isolated `mix test test/zaq/channels/message_timestamp_test.exs` and `mix q` through Context Mode; confirm both new cases pass, old property/valid-date test stays intact, then at the approved coverage phase produce a fresh `mix coveralls.json` report (600000 ms) followed on success by `mix coverup`; verify lines 22 and 29 hit and review meaningful branches, documenting any exception. Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md for final `mix precommit` gate (900000 ms) only when requesting final human approval. No E2E: pure date conversion has no UI journey or listed E2E-triggering domain.
title: [zaq-aun] [coverage] Cover MessageTimestamp malformed date branches (lines 22, 29)
